notes.title: "Real-Time Assist Replay Time ～1 min until closing～" released for free today!
notes.notes:
"Honwaka Fuwafuwa" has released its latest game, "Real-time Assist Replay Time: The Last Minute Before Closing," for free today!

It's a mini-game where you can enjoy a score attack-style experience with ultra-fast-paced "ART" slot action. The game features achievements and Steam leaderboards.

In addition, you can enjoy the game with the same characters from their previous works, "HIGH & LOW ~ Aim! 26 consecutive wins! Road to 5,000 trillion yen ~" and "School Sweets Discovery ～granulated sugar edition～"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2310720/

notes.title: "Real-time Assist Replay Time"is now available on GooglePlayStore
notes.notes:
"Honwaka Fluffy" is January 26, 2023,
You can enjoy ART's RTA and it's perfect for killing time in line from 9:50,
We are pleased to announce that the original beautiful girl slot-style mini-game "Real-time assist replay time-1 minute until closing" has started distribution on the Google Play store.
The price is free.
In addition, the game features some of the same characters as "Discovery of Gakuen Sweets ~Zarame no Donut Edition~".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282754/cefeac349704dde1d2d6dc6e5b5fae6aebcf198b.png[/img]

This is also a game that can be played easily.

■Delivery URL
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HonwakaFuwafuwa.RTART

■"Real-time assist replay time ~1 minute until closing~" is an original game with the motif of a pachislot ART.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282754/daf0d557003c6158de00a2f95e4bdf11a9136321.png[/img]
I went into the bonus just before closing time! "How much can you take in the remaining 1 minute!" Based on such a "something with a slotter" setting, you can enjoy the time you spend crunching and increasing your medals.

■Killing time from 9:50, perfect for image training!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282754/3441a21b84347e1d7bfb45312fcffab756ab45ff.png[/img]
This game is an original slot, and if you always press it in the order you press it, it is set to have a very high probability of getting a child role.
A payout of 16 or more cards that does not exist in reality, and an ultra-high net increase are perfect for raising the tension.
The lottery is over, and there are only 10 minutes left until the store opens... I can't kill a long time, but I want to get excited while waiting... It's the perfect app for killing time in the morning from 9:50.

■Let's taste the essence of "comfort"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282754/51716fa8bcd093b03119df70ccd3fb7cf1b610f7.png[/img]
There are two characters, and the assist voice is also taken down.
By repeating endless mode and auto mode, you can listen to voices such as "Left! Right! Middle! Yay!"
If you start it and leave it in endless mode or auto mode, you can use it as a comfortable BGM generator.
　There are illustrations by guest illustrators and songs by guest musicians, so you can enjoy a sense of variety.

■Let's compete in the ranking!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282754/482bcd47d2d8e21d561dc23e5e05a024a129c035.png[/img]
There is an online ranking that competes for how many coins you can earn in one minute.
Combined with the Twitter posting function with screenshots, you can share a large number of balls with others.
 
 ■Delivery URL
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HonwakaFuwafuwa.RTART

notes.title: About the policy for dealing with user names that seem inappropriate
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patronage of "School Sweets Discovery ～granulated sugar edition～".

Regarding the "ranking" that can be registered in the game
If an inappropriate name is registered, we will correct it.
If it is repeated, consider excluding it from the ranking.

It's painful to put restrictions because I want you to have fun playing.
On the other hand, I hope that many other people will enjoy playing.

Thank you for your understanding.
